jp-20260910-news-2.title: Inbound visitor numbers in August likely on pace for a record high; tailwind from weak yen contrasted with widening accommodation taxes causing divergent responses in tourist destinations

segments.src: ## 円安を背景に訪日需要が引き続き高水準
segments.tr: ## Inbound demand remains at high levels against the backdrop of a weak yen

segments.src: 歴史的な水準の円安が続くなか、8月の訪日外国人旅行者数も過去最多クラスのペースで推移しているとみられる。夏休み期間と重なったこともあり、欧米やアジア各国・地域からの旅行者が都市部の観光地や温泉地、リゾート地に集中する動きが続いた。航空便や宿泊施設の予約状況を見ても、主要都市では前年を上回る稼働率が報告されており、インバウンド需要の勢いは当面続くとの見方が広がっている。
segments.tr: Amid the continuation of a historically weak yen, the number of foreign visitors to Japan in August is also estimated to have trended at a pace close to a record high. Coinciding with the summer vacation period, the movement of travelers from Europe, the Americas, and various Asian countries and regions concentrating in urban tourist spots, hot springs, and resort areas continued. Looking at airline and accommodation reservation statuses, occupancy rates exceeding those of the previous year have been reported in major cities, and the view that the momentum of inbound demand will continue for the time being is spreading.

segments.src: 円安は海外からの旅行者にとって「割安な日本旅行」という強い動機付けとなっており、宿泊費や飲食費、買い物などの消費額を押し上げる効果も出ている。一部の百貨店や免税店では、訪日客による消費が売り上げ全体をけん引する構図が定着しつつあるとされる。
segments.tr: The weak yen serves as a strong motivation for overseas travelers for "affordable travel to Japan," and it is also producing the effect of boosting spending amounts on lodging, dining, and shopping. In some department stores and duty-free shops, the pattern where consumption by inbound visitors drives overall sales is reportedly becoming established.

segments.src: ## 混雑緩和へ、宿泊税を新設・引き上げる自治体が増加
segments.tr: ## Increasing number of municipalities newly establishing or raising accommodation taxes to ease congestion

segments.src: その一方で、急増する観光客への対応として、宿泊税を新たに導入したり、税率を引き上げたりする自治体が相次いでいる。背景にあるのは、オーバーツーリズム(観光公害)への懸念だ。特定の観光地では、道路や公共交通機関の混雑、ごみ処理やトイレなどインフラへの負荷、住民の生活環境への影響が課題として指摘されてきた。
segments.tr: On the other hand, as a response to the rapidly increasing tourists, municipalities are successively newly introducing accommodation taxes or raising tax rates. Behind this lies concerns over overtourism. In specific tourist destinations, congestion on roads and public transportation, burdens on infrastructure such as garbage disposal and restrooms, and impacts on the living environment of residents have been pointed out as issues.

segments.src: 宿泊税は、観光客が宿泊施設を利用する際に一定額を負担する仕組みで、得られた税収は観光案内板の整備や多言語対応、公共交通の増便、環境美化など、観光関連のインフラ整備や受け入れ環境の改善に充てられるのが一般的だ。人気の高い観光地を抱える自治体を中心に、財源確保と混雑緩和を両立させる手段として関心が高まっている。
segments.tr: The accommodation tax is a mechanism where tourists bear a certain amount when using accommodation facilities, and the tax revenue obtained is generally allocated to tourism-related infrastructure development and the improvement of the welcoming environment, such as the maintenance of tourist information boards, multilingual support, increasing public transportation services, and environmental beautification. Interest is growing, centered around municipalities with popular tourist destinations, as a means to balance securing financial resources and easing congestion.

segments.src: ## 観光地によって分かれる姿勢
segments.tr: ## Postures that differ depending on tourist destinations

segments.src: もっとも、すべての自治体が同じ方向を向いているわけではない。宿泊税の導入・引き上げに積極的な地域がある一方で、地域経済への影響を懸念し、慎重な姿勢を崩さない自治体も少なくない。宿泊単価の上昇が旅行者離れを招き、かえって地域全体の観光収入を減らしかねないとの懸念や、近隣の自治体との税率差が旅行者の宿泊地選びに影響を与える可能性を指摘する声もある。
segments.tr: However, not all municipalities are facing the same direction. While there are regions active in introducing and raising accommodation taxes, quite a few municipalities maintain a cautious stance due to concerns about the impact on the local economy. There are also voices pointing out concerns that an increase in accommodation unit prices could drive travelers away and potentially reduce tourism revenue for the region as a whole, as well as the possibility that tax rate differences with neighboring municipalities could influence travelers' selection of lodging locations.

segments.src: このため、税率や課税方式(定額制か定率制か、免税となる宿泊料金の下限をどこに設定するかなど)は自治体ごとに異なり、制度設計は手探りの状態が続いている。観光関連事業者からは、税負担の在り方だけでなく、増えた税収が実際にどのような形で受け入れ環境の改善に使われるのか、使途の透明性を求める声も上がっている。
segments.tr: For this reason, tax rates and taxation methods (such as whether it is a flat-rate system or a proportional system, and where to set the lower limit for accommodation fees exempt from tax) differ by municipality, and system design continues to be in a state of trial and error. Voices from tourism-related businesses are also calling for transparency in how the increased tax revenue will actually be used to improve the welcoming environment, not just the nature of the tax burden.

segments.src: 今後については、円安基調がどこまで続くかに加え、各自治体の宿泊税に関する制度設計や、政府による観光政策の方向性が、訪日客数や観光地ごとの人気度に影響を与えるとみられる。持続可能な観光地づくりに向けては、観光客数の量的な拡大だけでなく、地域住民の生活環境との両立や、観光収入をいかに地域全体に還元していくかという視点が、これまで以上に重要になりそうだ。
segments.tr: Regarding the future, in addition to how long the weak-yen trend will continue, the system design regarding accommodation taxes by each municipality and the direction of tourism policies by the government are expected to influence the number of inbound visitors and the degree of popularity for each tourist destination. Toward creating sustainable tourist destinations, the perspective of not only quantitative expansion in the number of tourists, but also achieving a balance with the living environment of local residents and how to return tourism revenue to the entire region, is likely to become more important than ever.

segments.src: 旅行者にとっても、訪問先によって宿泊費に上乗せされる税額や制度が異なる点は、旅行計画を立てるうえで押さえておきたいポイントの一つといえる。
segments.tr: For travelers as well, the fact that the tax amount and system added to accommodation costs differ depending on the destination can be said to be one of the points to keep in mind when making travel plans.
